create_tokenizer_layoutxlm: create a LayoutXLMTokenizer instance with vocab, special token boxes, and word label settings
encode_text_with_boxes: encode pretokenized text with bounding boxes and optional word labels using LayoutXLMTokenizer
batch_encode_text_boxes: batch encode multiple pretokenized text sequences with bounding boxes and word labels
pad_encoded_inputs_bbox: pad encoded inputs to a maximum length with bounding boxes and attention masks
build_inputs_special_tokens: build model inputs from token sequences by concatenating and adding special tokens
